# Relationship change watch

`customer_support.pb.churn_signal_detection.relationship_change_watch` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Watch for a change in who contacts us, not only in how much. Flag when the habitual contact goes silent and an unfamiliar name appears in their place.

A reassignment or a disengagement of the internal power user removes the person who would have argued for the renewal. The account's ticket volume can be unchanged while its advocacy has gone to zero.
